findings.evidence: Mathlib's prefix/suffix split for argument position: `Polynomial.neg_comp : (-p).comp q = -p.comp q` (Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Eval/Defs.lean:773) vs `ContinuousLinearMap.comp_neg`/`neg_comp` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/ContinuousLinearMap/Basic.lean:873,880).
findings.fix: Rename to `neg_spinStructureOne`, `neg_spinStructureTwo`, `neg_fromG1G2` (and update the simp uses at :295 and the module docstring at :54-56), matching `neg_bilinMap`. `IsG1G2Decomposition.neg` (:353) may stay as dot notation.
findings.issue: `spinStructureOne_neg` (:208), `spinStructureTwo_neg` (:213) and `fromG1G2_neg` (:292) negate the *first* argument `ε`, but use a `_neg` suffix, which by positional convention names the last argument: `fromG1G2_neg` reads as `fromG1G2 ε K g₁ (-g₂)` and `spinStructureOne_neg` as negating `K`. The same PR already uses the prefix form for first-argument negation (`AlternatingMap.neg_bilinMap`, Alternating/BilinMap.lean:138, for `(-f).bilinMap m`), and the suffix is taken by the second-argument lemmas `spinStructureOne_reverse`/`fromG1G2_reverse`.

findings.evidence: Line 119-120: RHS is `g K.p K.q • spinStructureOne ε K - g K.S K.q • ε.bilinMap ![K.q, K.p]`; line 242: RHS is `(√(K.M2 g) / g K.p K.q) • ε.bilinMap ![...]`.
findings.fix: Rename to e.g. `spinStructureTwo_eq_smul_sub_smul` (or `..._eq_sub`) and `fromG1G2_eq_smul_bilinMap`; both adjacent names already do this properly (`spinStructureTwo_eq_smul_spinStructureOne`, :125).
findings.issue: `spinStructureTwo_eq` carries a bare `_eq` that says nothing about the conclusion `(p·q) • E₁ - (S·q) • ε.bilinMap ![q,p]`; a naming convention requires the name to describe the conclusion. Same file, `fromG1G2_eq_bilinMap` (:241) equates `fromG1G2` with a *scalar multiple* of `ε.bilinMap …`, not with a `bilinMap`.

summary: Namespaces, the Is*/is*_iff forms, the witness names and the Matrix.det_fin_four pairing all follow convention, and no notation is added. Two defects: the ε-negation lemmas use a positionally misleading `_neg` suffix that contradicts the PR's own `neg_bilinMap`, and two `_eq` names do not describe their right-hand sides.
